releases.name: v0.1.2 — jev Decisions API judge
releases.body:
First release shipping the jev (TypeSafe System One Decisions API) judge path.

- `jevReview`: dedicated decisions-endpoint judge with calibrated p(safe)/p(el)/p(hr), threshold policy via `AGENTPOLICE_JEV_HR_MIN` / `AGENTPOLICE_JEV_EL_MIN` (default 0.3/0.3)
- Native human-review dialog
- Background monitor (Phase E) + adversarial roleplay benchmark tooling

Bench: jev-latest 235/240 on the 240-fixture set. Verified: published tarball contains the jev code path (`src/reviewer.ts`).
